description.narrative: The purpose of the ASEAN NZ Collaboration Fund (ANZCF) is for ASEAN and New Zealand to deliver on, or realize, shared development and regional priorities through enabling responsive and flexible cooperation and engagement. The Fund will support initiatives across three thematic areas: governance and security, economic cooperation and climate change and environment.
